title: Senate Rejects Resolution to End Iran War, 49-50
detail: The Senate voted 49-50 against a War Powers Resolution that would have directed Trump to remove US forces from hostilities against Iran absent congressional authorization. Republicans Rand Paul, Susan Collins, Lisa Murkowski and Thom Tillis joined Democrats in favor; Democrat John Fetterman voted against. It was the 14th such vote since the US and Israel began bombing Iran on Feb. 28, and the non-binding resolution carries no legal force.

media.caption: Senate rejects the 14th Iran war powers resolution, 49-50

title: Federal Judge Orders White House to Restore CNN, MS NOW and Politico Access
detail: US District Judge Timothy Kelly — a 2017 Trump nominee — issued a temporary restraining order requiring the White House to restore press credentials for CNN, MS NOW and Politico for 14 days while their First Amendment lawsuit proceeds, finding the ban was "most likely unconstitutional" because the outlets were not given notice or a chance to be heard before losing access. Reporters were initially still turned away Thursday morning despite the order before gaining access that afternoon.

media.caption: CNN, MS NOW and Politico reporters return to the White House after a federal judge's order

title: Trump Hosts Xi Jinping at White House State Dinner
detail: President Trump and First Lady Melania Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife Peng Liyuan at a White House state dinner in the East Room, attended by more than 100 guests including tech executives Elon Musk, Jeff Bezos, Mark Zuckerberg, Sundar Pichai and Sam Altman. Xi announced two giant pandas would be sent to Zoo Atlanta.

media.caption: Trump welcomes Xi Jinping to the White House for a state dinner
